construct: a shift register tracking in-flight requests with a separate count of set bits
style: state the property as a guarded check: always @(posedge clk) if (guard) assert (expr); where the guard is a real design condition, not a constant
pattern: Chain Precedence: a three-step order - arm, then start, then finish - enforced by a small state machine, so a later step can never be observed unless the earlier ones happened
scope: after Q: keep a sticky arm register set the first time an event Q happens and never cleared afterwards; the property is required only while that register is high. List the arm register in antecedents.

scope: after Q: keep a sticky arm register set the first time an event Q happens and never cleared afterwards; the property is required only while that register is high. List the arm register in antecedents.

construct: a DMA burst engine with a beats-remaining counter; the busy flag is up exactly while beats remain
style: give the module TWO assertions that both need the same relation R: neither is inductive alone, and R closes both

style: state the property as a guarded check: always @(posedge clk) if (guard) assert (expr); where the guard is a real design condition, not a constant
pattern: Precedence: if something is observed now, something else must have happened earlier - keep a shadow register recording the earlier event or value, and assert the relation between the shadow and the present state
scope: after Q: keep a sticky arm register set the first time an event Q happens and never cleared afterwards; the property is required only while that register is high. List the arm register in antecedents.

style: state the property about the PREVIOUS cycle using $past, gated by a past-valid register so cycle zero is not judged: reg pv = 0; always @(posedge clk) pv <= 1; always @(posedge clk) if (pv) assert (out == $past(in));
pattern: Universality: a relation between the design's registers holds in every reachable state
scope: after Q until R: keep a window register set by Q and cleared by R, where R may never arrive, so the property must hold from Q onwards whether or not the window ever closes. List the window register in antecedents.

construct: an in-flight tracker for a pipelined unit: issue increments, a fixed-latency shift register drains; occupancy equals the ones in the shift register
style: state the property as a guarded check: always @(posedge clk) if (guard) assert (expr); where the guard is a real design condition, not a constant
pattern: Precedence: if something is observed now, something else must have happened earlier - keep a shadow register recording the earlier event or value, and assert the relation between the shadow and the present state
scope: after Q until R: keep a window register set by Q and cleared by R, where R may never arrive, so the property must hold from Q onwards whether or not the window ever closes. List the window register in antecedents.

temperature: n/a: removed from the API on this model; effort + seed rotation are the diversity knobs
construct: a FIFO with separate write and read pointers plus an occupancy counter; full and empty are derived, and occupancy always equals the pointer difference
style: state the property about the PREVIOUS cycle using $past, gated by a past-valid register so cycle zero is not judged: reg pv = 0; always @(posedge clk) pv <= 1; always @(posedge clk) if (pv) assert (out == $past(in));
pattern: Precedence: if something is observed now, something else must have happened earlier - keep a shadow register recording the earlier event or value, and assert the relation between the shadow and the present state
scope: before R: keep a register that starts high and is cleared the first time an event R happens; the property is required only while it is still high, that is, before R has ever occurred. List it in antecedents.

construct: an in-flight tracker for a pipelined unit: issue increments, a fixed-latency shift register drains; occupancy equals the ones in the shift register
style: state the property as a fact checked on the clock edge: always @(posedge clk) assert (expr);
pattern: Precedence: if something is observed now, something else must have happened earlier - keep a shadow register recording the earlier event or value, and assert the relation between the shadow and the present state
scope: between Q and R: keep a window register, set by Q and cleared by R, and require the property only inside the window; the design must be able to open and close the window more than once. List the window register in antecedents.

style: give the module TWO assertions that both need the same relation R: neither is inductive alone, and R closes both
pattern: Universality: a relation between the design's registers holds in every reachable state
scope: after Q: keep a sticky arm register set the first time an event Q happens and never cleared afterwards; the property is required only while that register is high. List the arm register in antecedents.
